title: Ndidi nke Mkpụrụ Obi A Na-ahụju Anya
intro: N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, e nwere otu onye aha ya na ntachi obi pụtara. A nwalere onye a site n'itufu nkasi obi ụwa niile, mana ọ nọgidere bụrụ ohu nke Onye Okike. N'ime ọtụtụ afọ nke ihe isi ike na ọrịa anụ ahụ, obi mkpụrụ obi a nọgidere na-eguzosi ike n'okwukwe, na-enye olileanya maka ndị niile na-eche nsogbu ihu.
clues: Abụ m ohu Allah nke kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi, e nyere m akụnụba dị ukwuu, ọtụtụ ụmụ, na ahụike dị mma.
Ndụ m gbanwere mgbe a napụrụ m akụ̀ na ụba m na ezinụlọ m, nke mere ka m ghara inwe ihe ọ bụla ma e wezụga okwukwe m.
Ọrịa na-egbu mgbu nke na-adịgide ogologo oge nke na-anwale oke ntachi obi mmadụ.
N'oge niile m na-ata ahụhụ, ekweghị m ime mkpesa megide Onyenwe m, ọbụlagodi mgbe onye iro gbalịrị iduga m n'ọnọdụ ịda mbà n'obi.
Mgbe m mechara kpọọ Onyenwe m òkù, arịọghị m akụnụba, kama m kwetara na nsogbu emetụla m aka.
A gwara m ka m kụọ ụwa n'ụkwụ m, isi iyi mmiri oyi sikwa na ya pụta iji gwọọ ahụ m ma mee ka akpịrị kpọọ m nkụ.

arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
